material: hexagonal MnTe (NiAs type, P6_3/mmc), HSE06 + spin-orbit coupling (VASP 5.4.4), in-plane Neel order
source: Zenodo record 18863304 (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.18863304, CC BY 4.0): data for K. P. Kluczyk et al., Phys. Rev. B 110, 155201 (2024): 1_vasp, 2_wannier90, 3_wannsymm, 4_wtools of dft_data.zip and fig6_script.zip

staged_files.note: archive files unchanged, except 4_wtools/WT.out without its k-point progress lines ("ik/knv3 ..."); not staged: 2_wannier90/wannier90_hr.dat (evaluated by the service) and 4_wtools/sigma_ahc.txt (withheld)

wannier_model.basis: Mn d (dz2, dxz, dyz, dx2-y2, dxy) on Mn1, Mn2, then Te p (pz, px, py) on Te1, Te2, spin up (functions 1-16) then spin down (17-32), spin quantised along Cartesian z

neel.-y: time reverse of the archived Hamiltonian, H(R) -> (i s_y) H(R)* (i s_y)^dagger: all moments reversed

request_size_limit: a request body may not exceed 65536 bytes (round coordinates; about 1000 k-points fit)

conventions.k_frac: coordinates in the reciprocal basis b_i of the POSCAR cell (k_cart = k_frac @ B)
conventions.k_cart_invA: Cartesian k in 1/Angstrom including 2 pi, axes of the POSCAR cell
conventions.energies: absolute eV on the scale of the Wannier Hamiltonian (the VASP scale)
conventions.mesh: Gamma-centred N x N x N/2 mesh of fractional coordinates (i/N, j/N, l/(N/2))
conventions.berry_curvature: Omega_n = curl_k i<u_n|grad_k u_n> (Angstrom^2), Kubo formula, velocity in the atomic (Wannier-centre) gauge with the centres at the atomic positions, as WannierTools 2.6.1 does
conventions.ahc: sigma_ab = (e^2/hbar) (1/(N_k V)) sum_k sum_n f(E_n - mu) Omega^c_n in S/cm, (a, b, c) cyclic, Fermi-Dirac f with the given kT; electrons_per_cell counts the 32 Wannier bands
